headline: Software Engineer @Techpolo Technologies | Full Stack Engineer | MERN | Agentic AI | Open Source Contributor | Co-Mentor @DevWeekends

sections.bio: I build full stack products end to end, covering architecture, implementation, deployment, and the debugging that comes once real users start pushing on the system. Over the past year my focus has shifted toward AI driven systems and the automation they enable for businesses.𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗜 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸I think through architecture before writing a single line of code, because a system that looks fine in a demo and one that holds up under real traffic are two very different things. I care about how a product behaves once people are actually using it: where it breaks, where it slows down, and how it recovers. That same standard carries into how I contribute outside my own projects. I look for places where I can add real value to work built by other people, treating someone else's codebase with the same care I'd give my own, and I've had contributions accepted into established open source projects as a result. It's a different discipline than shipping something you designed from scratch, and it's made me a more careful engineer overall. 𝗠𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽I co-mentor engineers through a fellowship of 2000+ developers, working with people on the same underlying question: how do you take a feature that technically works and turn it into a system that survives contact with real users. 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗗𝗡𝗔Next.js, MERN Stack, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, RTK Query, Tailwind CSS, Docker, GitHub Actions, C++, Python 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵 𝗢𝘂𝘁[email protected]
